title: 高盛Joe：韩国台湾AI过热？央行加息节奏大不同
speaker: Joe

segments.en: There are a lot of similarities. Besides capex, we're also seeing consumer spillover in both economies. If you look at retail sales on a three-month average basis, Taiwan is seeing retail sales at around 8% year over year. Korea was higher in the middle of the year at 6%, now is around 4%.
segments.zh: 有很多相似之处。除了资本开支，两个经济体也看到消费传导。看三个月平均零售销售，台湾同比约8%。韩国年中更高达6%，现在约4%。

segments.en: So definitely you're seeing that spillover both into corporate capex and consumer spending. But what is interesting is that you're seeing very different reaction in terms of monetary policy in these two economies. The Bank of Korea already raised twice.
segments.zh: 所以确实看到传导到企业资本开支和消费支出。但有趣的是，两个经济体的货币政策反应非常不同。韩国央行已经加息两次。

segments.en: And we're expecting them to continue with interest rate hikes two more times for the next six months. That's on top of echoing what you're saying: you're seeing not just the tech boom, but it's increasingly spilling to overall economic growth.
segments.zh: 我们预计未来六个月他们还会再加息两次。这呼应了你的说法：不仅是科技繁荣，而且正越来越多传导到整体经济增长。

segments.en: The case with Taiwan is interesting because despite our finding that they have more domestic spillover, the Taiwan CBC was on hold in September. So what we think that means is that the case for further monetary tightening in Taiwan is also getting stronger. As a result, we do expect the CBC to move forward with a rate hike in their upcoming December monetary meeting.
segments.zh: 台湾的情况有趣，尽管我们发现其国内传导更多，但台湾央行9月按兵不动。我们认为这意味着台湾进一步收紧货币政策的理由也在增强。因此，我们预计台湾央行将在12月会议上加息。
